title: Snap a receipt. It files itself.
hook: Snap a receipt. It files itself.
summary:
Snap a receipt. It files itself.
No more shoebox of receipts at month end. Photo to a Telegram bot, AI reads merchant, date, total, VAT and category, a row lands in your expenses sheet, and you get a monthly summary.
Tools: Telegram, an AI model with JSON output, Google Sheets.
Got a boring task? Comment it below and I might automate it in the next episode. Small business? DM me AUDIT.
